subject: CAIQ evidence subledger: sampling protocol and escrow onboarding
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena@helmsoft.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@helmsoft.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ evidence subledger - sampling protocol request

Hi Elliot,

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. HelmSoft needs to onboard Redwood's CAIQ responses into our assurance ledger. Our audit team asked whether you can:

- Provide a short sampling protocol that explains how you select runtime log samples and config snapshots when we request evidence for a control (e.g., what windows, how you anonymize, retention TTLs).
- Share a compact "subledger" mapping that lists which CAIQ questions map to live artifacts (logs, KMS attestations, SSO configs, SOC 2 report sections).
- Confirm any special handling for escrowed artifacts (we typically require a 90-day staging period).

Can you send a concise plan + sample artifacts we can ingest into our portal? Ideally by EOD PST so our intake team can queue it.

Thanks,
Lena
Lena Park
Head of Security Programs, HelmSoft

--
Attachment: intake-template.csv (referenced for fields we will ingest)

From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Park <lena@helmsoft.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence subledger - sampling protocol request

Hi Lena —

Appreciate the clear ask. Looping in Kimberly (control mapping & evidence owner) and Marissa (evidence ops) to provide a compact package. High-level answers below; we'll follow with the subledger file + short README and a DocuSign access token for escrow forms.

Quick answers:
1) Sampling protocol (summary):
   - Standard window: we extract a 7-day contiguous window for telemetry artifacts, aligned to UTC days.
   - If you request a longer lookback, we can provide up to 90 days of sampled segments (non-contiguous, stratified by peak/off-peak).
   - Anonymization: user identifiers are hashed with a per-account salt; PII fields are redacted before export.
   - Chain-of-custody: each artifact export includes a signed manifest with SHA256 digests and timestamps.

2) Subledger mapping:
   - We'll deliver an XLSX that maps CAIQ question IDs to artifact types, owner, retention TTL, and suggested ingestion field names for your portal.

3) Escrow handling:
   - For artifacts designated for escrow, we stage them in a restricted bucket with 90-day retention by default; access requires a short-lived signed URL and an escrow acceptance form (DocuSign).

Kimberly/Marissa — action items below.

Elliot
Head of Compliance Programs (Acting)
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>, Lena Park <lena@helmsoft.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 12:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence subledger - sampling protocol request

Hi all,

I've attached the subledger mapping and a short README that explains field names and provenance. Highlights:

- File: caiq-subledger-mapping.xlsx (attached)
  - Columns: CAIQ_ID, Control_Label, Artifact_Type, Owner, TTL_days, Export_field_name, Notes
  - Example: A2.01 -> "Key lifecycle management" -> Artifact: KMS rotation logs -> TTL: 365 -> Export_field_name: kms_rotation_event

- Evidence-sample-README.pdf (attached)
  - Explains sampling windows (7-day default), stratification rules, redaction policy, and manifest format.

Escrow specifics: we mark escrow artifacts with Escrow=true in the mapping and include a "staging_bucket" field. Escrow artifacts will be immutably archived for the requested retention and require signed acceptance before credentials are provisioned.

Please review and confirm whether the column set aligns with HelmSoft's ingestion template. If you need additional fields (e.g., internal_ticket_id), tell us and we can add a light transform layer.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Control Mapping & Evidence
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments:

Hi Lena —

Thanks Kimberly — attaching the delivery checklist and the DocuSign access token (link file attached). Operational notes:

- Delivery cadence: we can provide one-time exports, weekly rolling packages, or an ad-hoc export (24-48h SLA) depending on agreement.
- Authentication: exports use a short-lived (1h) presigned URL to the escrow bucket. We will not include raw PII.
- Audit trail: each export includes a manifest.json with SHA256 checksums and the platform user who requested the export.

Action items for HelmSoft:
- Confirm ingestion column set by EOD PST tomorrow (2027-03-03).
- Sign the escrow acceptance (DocuSign) — see docsign-access-link.txt attached.
- Tell us preferred delivery cadence (one-time vs weekly).

We'll stand by to stage a sample package once those are confirmed.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference
